notes: Not automated: [Once Per Turn] If one of your Characters with 6000 base power or less would be removed from the field by your opponent, you may add 1 card from the top of your Life cards to your hand instead.

abilities.text: [On Play] Play up to 1 red Character card with a cost of 2 or less from your hand.
